projects.review: The Little Prince Among the Stars takes us on a journey through eight tiny planets inspired by the world of The Little Prince. Don't expect big challenges or action-packed gameplay: the real charm lies in wandering through its environments, discovering hidden corners, and soaking up its magical, nostalgic atmosphere. And here's the surprising part: this entire little universe was created in just 16 days with the help of AI. A simple experience with plenty of personality, and one that's definitely worth exploring, even if just for a few minutes.

projects.title: Lost Marbles

gallery.alt: Starting a game in Lost Marbles

projects.review: Lost Marbles throws you into a chaotic race where up to 50 marbles compete to be the last one rolling. Navigate tricky tracks, dodge obstacles, and grab upgrades to stay ahead of the competition. With each round eliminating the slowest racers, things get more intense as you get closer to the finish line. It's a fun, fast-paced experience that's easy to jump into, but winning is a whole different story!

projects.title: The Shipwright

gallery.alt: Playing with colors in The Shipwright

projects.review: The Shipwright is a charming interactive 3D experience that turns shipbuilding into a playful exercise in creativity. Rather than following traditional game mechanics, it invites you to experiment with shapes, colors, materials, and details to design your own unique vessel. Watching your creation take shape in real time makes the process surprisingly satisfying, while the atmospheric ocean setting adds an extra layer of immersion. With its polished visuals and intuitive customization tools, The Shipwright feels like a delightful little digital playground where curiosity and creativity take the helm.

projects.title: Roadster
projects.review: Inspired by Tesla's jaw-dropping Roadster reveal, this playful 3D experience brings the car's gravity-defying stunts straight to your browser. Watch the Roadster race up a massive ramp, flip through the air, and land on its wheels with the help of rocket-like thrusters. A fun little tribute to one of Tesla's wildest demonstrations, recreated in an interactive digital playground.
